body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Navisis presented ''EZ-Canvas'' attachable acryl panel that can transform regular LCS/CRT monitor into a pen-driven touch-screen. The two super sonic sensors located on the top of both sides of the panel can detect movement of a pen and the pen locates a mouse pointer. This acryl panel can be used as either a touch screen or a tablet pc.

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
